Yes, this matches what I want. Typing "Rome" pulled up the two links that actually mention Rome, and then clicking the "Travel" tag narrowed it down to just the one travel bookmark. Being able to search by words and then layer a tag on top to zero in — that combination is exactly how I'd want to find things.

And your two assumptions feel right to me: I didn't expect it to search the entire hidden contents of the page, just what I can see — the title, the description, and the address — and that's what it's doing. Having the tags sitting right above the list so I can click one is handy too; that works well.

One thing I noticed while testing that I want to check: the search seemed to treat "Rome" and "rome" the same, which is what I'd want — I shouldn't have to match capitalization. Can you confirm that's on purpose?

And a note for later, not blocking this: if I've jotted my own note onto a bookmark, I'd expect that to be searchable too, the same as the description. But the core of what you showed — word search plus tag filter — is right. Good to continue.
